news.title: Lijemrakel Trading PLC Strengthens International Sourcing for Veterinary Medicines & Vaccines
news.excerpt: Expanding supplier partnerships with certified international manufacturers to ensure reliable veterinary pharmaceutical and biological supply across Ethiopia.
news.content:
## Advancing Reliable Veterinary Supply in Ethiopia

Lijemrakel Trading PLC continues to expand its international supplier network to ensure that veterinary professionals, livestock producers, and commercial poultry farms across Ethiopia have consistent access to essential animal health products.

Our portfolio spans four core therapeutic classes of veterinary medicines—anthelmintics, antibiotics, antiprotozoals, and multivitamin supplements—alongside preventive vaccines, feed premixes, reproductive hormones, and certified fertilized hatching eggs.

## Technical Evaluation & Regulatory Stewardship

Every supplier partnership begins with rigorous technical evaluation led by our veterinary and regulatory team. We review manufacturer certifications, active ingredient specifications, stability data, and approved product labeling to ensure full compliance with Ethiopian veterinary authority requirements.

By combining technical oversight with disciplined import logistics, we help safeguard livestock health, farm productivity, and food safety across the agricultural value chain.

news.title: Expanding Poultry & Dairy Feed Premix Supply Across Bishoftu, Adama, and Regional Ethiopian Farm Corridors
news.excerpt: Delivering balanced vitamin, trace-mineral, and amino acid premix formulations to commercial feed mills, poultry clusters in Bishoftu and Mojo, and dairy cooperatives across Ethiopia.
news.content:
## Supporting Ethiopia’s High-Growth Poultry & Feed Mill Clusters

Commercial poultry and livestock producers across the Bishoftu (Debre Zeit), Mojo, Adama, and Addis Ababa agricultural belt rely on consistent micronutrient balance to maximize egg laying persistence, broiler weight gain, and feed conversion efficiency using local maize and oilseed cake rations.

From our headquarters in Bole Sub-City, Addis Ababa, Lijemrakel Trading PLC supplies high-stability vitamin, trace-mineral, and essential amino acid premixes engineered to complement Ethiopian feed raw materials and prevent nutritional deficiencies.

## Advancing Highland Dairy & Beef Cattle Productivity Under Yelemat Tirufat

In direct support of Ethiopia’s national Yelemat Tirufat dairy and poultry productivity program, our ruminant premix line provides bioavailable calcium, phosphorus, selenium, zinc, and vitamins A, D3, and E for peri-urban dairy farms in Sululta, Sebeta, Holeta, Bahir Dar, and Hawassa—strengthening herd fertility, milk yield, and calf immunity.

news.title: Ethiopian Poultry & Hatchery Roadmap: Advancing Domestic Day-Old Chick Capacity for Local Producers
news.excerpt: How Lijemrakel Trading PLC is bridging immediate fertilized hatching egg supply to Ethiopian hatcheries with Phase 3 domestic poultry breeding and incubation infrastructure.
news.content:
## Strengthening Ethiopia’s Domestic Poultry Value Chain

Ethiopia’s rapidly growing demand for table eggs and poultry meat requires a dependable supply of high-viability hatching eggs and disease-free day-old chicks. Lijemrakel Trading PLC currently partners with certified international parent-stock flocks to deliver sanitized, flock-certified fertilized hatching eggs directly to Ethiopian hatchery operators.

Every shipment undergoes strict veterinary health certification and Ethiopian Agricultural Authority (EAA) import verification prior to arrival in Addis Ababa.

## Phase 3 Domestic Hatchery & Biosecurity Infrastructure in Ethiopia

Under Phase 3 of our corporate strategy, Lijemrakel Trading PLC is preparing feasibility and biosecurity frameworks for modern domestic hatchery and breeder operations in Ethiopia—featuring automated setter and hatcher cabinets, Marek’s and Newcastle hatchery vaccination protocols, and regional chick delivery across Oromia, Amhara, Sidama, and SNNP.

news.title: From Bole Cargo Terminal to Regional Ethiopian Farms: Continuous Cold-Chain Logistics for Vaccines & Biologicals
news.excerpt: Maintaining unbroken +2°C to +8°C cold-chain integrity from Addis Ababa Bole International Airport customs clearance to veterinary clinics and poultry farms across Ethiopia.
news.content:
## Unbroken Cold-Chain Stewardship in Addis Ababa

Protecting the biological potency of Newcastle, Gumboro (IBD), Marek’s, Fowl Pox, and ruminant vaccines requires zero compromise during airfreight arrival and inland Ethiopian transit. Lijemrakel Trading PLC coordinates directly with Addis Ababa Bole International Airport cargo cold-chain facilities to transfer consignments immediately into monitored +2°C to +8°C cold rooms.

Our veterinary operations team inspects digital temperature loggers upon arrival to verify that every vaccine vial and reproductive hormone batch remained within specification throughout transit.

## Safe Last-Mile Delivery to Ethiopian Clinics & Hatcheries

Using insulated transport systems and verified lot tracking, we distribute temperature-sensitive biologicals and fertilized hatching eggs to commercial poultry farms, dairy cooperatives, and regional veterinary pharmacies across Ethiopia with full batch traceability.

news.title: Bole Sub-City Headquarters Opens Dedicated B2B Desk for Ethiopian Veterinary Clinics, Unions & Commercial Farms
news.excerpt: Connecting regional livestock cooperatives, private veterinary pharmacies, and commercial poultry enterprises directly with our technical and commercial desk in Addis Ababa.
news.content:
## Serving Ethiopian Livestock Unions, Clinics & Commercial Producers

Located in Bole Sub-City, Woreda 13 (Asamenewuel Building, 3rd Floor, Office No. 305) in Addis Ababa, Lijemrakel Trading PLC’s B2B Commercial & Technical Desk streamlines wholesale procurement for Ethiopian veterinary clinics, regional drug shops, poultry enterprises, and dairy unions.

Buyers across Addis Ababa, Oromia, Amhara, Sidama, South West Ethiopia, and Tigray can request product dossiers, veterinary prescription guidance, pack-size availability, and scheduled supply contracts across all five import categories.

## Trusted Ethiopian Market Representation for International Manufacturers

Our International Business division works closely with global veterinary pharmaceutical, vaccine, premix, and parent-stock breeding companies to manage Ethiopian Agricultural Authority (EAA) dossier registration, import permits, and nationwide technical promotion.

news.title: Ethiopian Leadership & Founding Vision: Building Trusted Veterinary & Agricultural Trade from Addis Ababa
news.excerpt: How Ethiopian founders Lijalem Abayneh, Dr Etsubdink Negash, and Abel Girma established Lijemrakel Trading PLC to advance livestock health and farm productivity nationwide.
news.content:
## An Ethiopian Enterprise Built on Veterinary Science & Trade Integrity

Headquartered in Addis Ababa, Lijemrakel Trading PLC was founded by Lijalem Abayneh, Dr Etsubdink Negash, and Abel Girma to address a critical need in Ethiopia’s agricultural economy: dependable, technically verified access to genuine veterinary medicines, vaccines, nutritional premixes, reproductive hormones, and fertilized hatching eggs.

By uniting veterinary clinical oversight with structured international procurement and Ethiopian regulatory compliance, our leadership team ensures that local farmers and veterinary professionals receive authentic, high-efficacy inputs.

## Investing in Ethiopia’s Long-Term Agricultural Transformation

Beyond import distribution, Lijemrakel Trading PLC is committed to reinvesting in domestic Ethiopian agricultural capacity—supporting rural and peri-urban livestock livelihoods, strengthening food security, and preparing for future domestic poultry and export value addition.

orbitFaqs.title: About Lijemrakel Trading PLC
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Lijemrakel Trading PLC** is an Ethiopian import and export company primarily focused on the veterinary, livestock, and poultry sectors.

We connect the Ethiopian market with dependable international manufacturers of **veterinary medicines, vaccines, feed premixes, hormones, and fertilized eggs**. Our long-term direction also includes **poultry production and hatchery development**, supporting livestock and poultry productivity in alignment with national agricultural priorities including *Gebeta Le Hager*.
suggestions: What is your mission and vision?

orbitFaqs.title: Mission, Vision & Core Values
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Our Mission:**
To supply quality veterinary and poultry-sector products through reliable international sourcing, responsible importation, and customer-focused distribution—supporting animal health, productive farms, and the development of Ethiopia’s agricultural economy.

**Our Vision:**
To become one of Ethiopia’s leading and most trusted suppliers of veterinary and poultry-sector products, while developing competitive poultry production and hatchery operations that contribute to sustainable agricultural growth.

**Core Values:**
• Quality and safety
• Integrity
• Agricultural impact
• Customer focus
• Professionalism
• Partnership
• Continuous improvement

orbitFaqs.title: 5-Year Strategic Roadmap (4 Phases)
orbitFaqs.answer:
Lijemrakel Trading PLC follows a structured **4-Phase, 5-Year Strategic Roadmap**:

• **Phase 1 — Foundation and Market Entry (Year 1):** Finalize supplier partnerships, complete regulatory registrations, establish storage & cold-chain procedures, and launch core veterinary and poultry-input imports.
• **Phase 2 — Market Expansion and Portfolio Growth (Years 2–3):** Expand regional customer coverage across Ethiopia, broaden registered medicines, vaccines, premixes, and fertilized egg supply.
• **Phase 3 — Poultry and Hatchery Development (Years 3–4):** Complete feasibility and biosecurity planning to launch or partner in poultry production and hatchery operations.
• **Phase 4 — Consolidation, Scale, and Export Readiness (Years 4–5):** Scale national distribution, strengthen hatchery output, and develop agricultural export opportunities.

orbitFaqs.title: Veterinary & Poultry Product Lines
orbitFaqs.answer:
Lijemrakel Trading PLC focuses on **5 core veterinary and poultry product divisions**:

1. **Veterinary Medicines:** Anthelmintics (Albendazole, Fenbendazole, Ivermectin), antibiotics (Oxytetracycline, Penicillin–Streptomycin, Amoxicillin), antiprotozoals (Toltrazuril, Amprolium, Diminazene), and vitamin/mineral supplements.
2. **Veterinary Vaccines:** Poultry and livestock immunization products managed under strict cold-chain (`+2°C to +8°C`) handling.
3. **Feed Premixes:** Broiler, layer, and ruminant vitamin-mineral premixes with verified inclusion rates.
4. **Hormones & Related Products:** Authorized veterinary reproductive and herd-management products for professional use.
5. **Fertilized Eggs:** Certified broiler and layer hatching eggs from healthy parent stock with veterinary health certification.

orbitFaqs.title: Veterinary Medicines
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Veterinary Medicines Division:**
We supply essential veterinary pharmaceuticals and nutritional supplements in line with national veterinary registration and stewardship requirements:

• **Anthelmintics & Antiparasitics:** Albendazole, Fenbendazole, and Ivermectin.
• **Antibacterials / Antibiotics:** Oxytetracycline, Penicillin–Streptomycin, and Amoxicillin.
• **Antiprotozoals & Anticoccidials:** Toltrazuril, Amprolium, and Diminazene aceturate.
• **Vitamins & Supportive Care:** Vitamin A-D3-E, B-Complex, Electrolytes, and mineral supplements.

orbitFaqs.title: Veterinary Vaccines & Cold-Chain Handling
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Veterinary Vaccines Division:**
We supply poultry and livestock vaccines supported by strict cold-chain storage (`+2°C to +8°C`), batch traceability, and technical guidance:

• **Poultry Vaccines:** Protection against major viral and bacterial poultry diseases (such as Newcastle disease, Infectious Bursal Disease / Gumboro, Infectious Bronchitis, and Fowl Pox).
• **Livestock Vaccines:** Preventive immunization for cattle, sheep, and goats in accordance with national veterinary schedules.
• **Cold-Chain Integrity:** Continuous temperature monitoring from international arrival through warehouse storage and customer dispatch.

orbitFaqs.title: Feed Premixes & Animal Nutrition
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Feed Premixes Division:**
We supply balanced vitamin-mineral premixes and nutritional concentrates for commercial poultry farms, livestock operations, and feed mills:

• **Poultry Nutrition:** Starter, grower, finisher broiler premixes and layer/breeder vitamin-mineral premixes.
• **Ruminant & Livestock Nutrition:** Dairy and beef cattle mineral-vitamin premixes.
• **Quality Assurance:** Clear manufacturer specifications, verified nutrient composition, and recommended inclusion rates (`e.g., 0.25% – 2.5%`).

orbitFaqs.title: Hormones & Reproductive Management Products
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Hormones & Related Products Division:**
We supply authorized veterinary reproductive hormones strictly for licensed veterinary professionals and supervised breeding programs where registered and permitted:

• **Clinical Applications:** Estrus synchronization, luteolysis, ovulation induction, and postpartum reproductive management in dairy and beef herds.
• **Stewardship:** Supplied exclusively in compliance with Ethiopian regulatory requirements, prescription rules, and approved label withdrawal periods.

orbitFaqs.title: Fertilized Hatching Eggs
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Fertilized Eggs Division:**
We source and import certified fertilized hatching eggs from reputable international parent-stock breeders for commercial hatcheries and poultry producers:

• **Broiler & Layer Genetics:** High-performing commercial broiler and layer hatching eggs.
• **Biosecurity & Certification:** Accompanied by official veterinary health certificates, flock vaccination histories, and import permits.
• **Climate-Controlled Logistics:** Handled under controlled temperature (`16°C–18°C`) and humidity (`75%–80% RH`) to preserve embryo viability and hatchability.

orbitFaqs.title: Poultry Production & Hatchery Development
orbitFaqs.answer:
**Poultry Production & Hatchery Development (Strategic Growth Area):**
Alongside our active veterinary and poultry-input import business, Lijemrakel Trading PLC is developing long-term capabilities in **Poultry Production** and **Hatchery Operations** (planned for **Phase 3: Years 3–4** of our strategic roadmap):

• **Poultry Production:** Planned development of biosecure broiler and layer operations with modern housing, balanced nutrition, and veterinary health management.
• **Hatchery Development:** Planned investment in modern setter and hatcher incubation systems, biosecurity workflows, and quality day-old chick supply.
• **National Alignment:** Supports domestic agricultural value-chain growth in alignment with *Gebeta Le Hager*.
